## 📋 Quality & Verification Checklist

- [ ] **Engine Decoupling:** Engine changes in `src/engine/` contain NO dependencies on React, DOM, or browser APIs.
- [ ] **Tests Pass:** `npm test` passes 100% with no regressions.
- [ ] **TDD Coverage:** New rules, keywords, or card abilities include automated test cases in `tests/`.
- [ ] **Type Safety:** `npm run typecheck` passes with zero TypeScript errors.
- [ ] **Linting:** `npm run lint` passes without warnings/errors.
- [ ] **Documentation / ADR:** If architectural decisions were made, an ADR was created/updated in `docs/decisions/`.
